offers.description: Available as an individual service pick ($100 USD for individuals / $200 USD for businesses, each for 5 days of live training + 5 days of dedicated support, 10 days total coverage), or as part of our comprehensive programs: Business Training ($2,000 USD for 60 days: 30d training + 30d guidance/materials, up to 20 seats, +$100/extra seat) or Personal Training ($1,000 USD for 30 days: 15d training + 15d guidance/materials, 1 person only). Clients are free to pick and choose their services. Full 195-country Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) supported across all service pricing.

serviceOutput: 60-90% Cloud API Cost Slashing: Migrating heavy query volumes to open-weight models (Llama 3, DeepSeek, Qwen).
vLLM & Ollama High-Throughput Serving: Implementing PagedAttention, continuous batching, and low-latency inference.
Quantization (GGUF, AWQ & GPTQ): Sizing 4-bit and 8-bit quantized models for budget on-prem GPUs and servers.
Air-Gapped Privacy & Zero Leakage: Running 100% offline, local inference guaranteeing zero third-party data egress.
LiteLLM Intelligent Hybrid Routing: Directing routine prompts to local engines while escalating edge cases to frontier APIs.
